scope: Default diagnostic occupancy ray update; no planning or control policy changes.

protocol.problem: Distance-spaced samples can clear the same cell more than once and clear the hit cell before adding hit evidence.
semantics: Each return ray clears each positive-length traversed half-open cell once, excluding its endpoint cell.
An in-grid endpoint receives exactly one occupied increment per return.
A zero-length ray only supplies endpoint evidence; an empty scan supplies no free-space evidence.
Outside-map ray portions do not consume traversal work; nonfinite/unrepresentable geometry is ignored.
Different returns remain independent; probability calibration, dynamic decay and no-return horizon clearing are outside scope.
protocol.oracle: Independent exact rational segment/rectangle intersection across every cell, including boundary and randomized dyadic input cases.
qualification: native release tests, fmt and strict Clippy
sensor-only output byte reproduction on latest 48 logs
parent/current physical dense stop comparison in both plants; all driving fields/streams fixed, only diagnostic occupancy may change

component.oracle: Independent exact rational per-cell segment intersections.
pre_repair_failures: hit cell cleared before occupied increment

retained_initial_check_failure.failure: Temporary disk exhausted during standard sensor replay; wrapper could not write its summary.
retained_initial_check_failure.retention: All residual bytes, including truncated records, verified after gzip encoding before removing raw duplicates. Earlier collected records remain in this directory and parent archives.
retained_initial_check_failure.cache_cleanup: Only /tmp/rustdrive-heading-history-target/debug was removed after all commands stopped. Source, pins and evidence retained.

required_check_collection_repair.cause: The collector checked blocked before its marker existed, then the producer finished during the same pass over later groups; it stopped before revisiting the first group.
required_check_collection_repair.note: No command, case, source input, acceptance gate or runtime source changed. Completed raw files were checked against the retained parent exactly as in the other 48 cases.
